candidates.description: These tokens represent the letters of the Hebrew alphabet.
This vector activates common Hebrew prefixes and non-English script characters used for grammatical affixation.
This vector activates on rare, non-standard punctuation marks, diacritics, and foreign characters across various scripts.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens or fragments in various non-English scripts, particularly Devanagari and Arabic/Urdu scripts.
This vector represents character n-grams and sub-word tokens associated with the Devanagari script and Sanskrit-derived text encodings.
This feature activates on Hindi script characters, sub-word tokens, and Hindi loanwords or phonemes.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Devanagari character 'भ' (bha) and its various vowel and consonant combinations.
This vector activates for retroflex and dental consonant characters and sub-word units used in Indic scripts such as Devanagari.
This vector activates for Hindi subword tokens and character fragments.
This vector activates for common conjunct consonants, syllables, and grammatical suffixes in Devanagari script.
